verdict.rationale: Gmail has a built-in Gemini assistant that can summarize threads, draft/refine emails, and perform organizational actions like deleting messages or adding labels on request (gmail-docs-13, gmail-docs-14, gmail-docs-23, gmail-docs-33), which is genuine task delegation to an in-product AI. However, the evidence only shows a handful of narrow, mostly single-step actions (summarize, draft, organize) rather than open-ended multi-step agentic task delegation, and there is no independent/hands-on corroboration of how well these Gemini actions work in practice. Missing for 10: evidence of broader autonomous/multi-step task execution, independent hands-on validation, and detail on limits of what can be delegated.
